- L16: str `"\n\nRuntime contract:\nReply only with the best policy sentence, in one short sentence.\n- Your name is PipeCAD's voice assistant; if asked your name or who you are, say: I'm PipeCAD's voice assistant.\n- Default to English. If the latest user message asks for English, reply in English only.\n- Do not switch to Hindi, Urdu, or another language unless the latest user message explicitly asks for that language.\n- If the user explicitly asks for a human, live agent, operator, representative, or handoff, say: A human agent can help; I can hand you off now.\n- Never offer a human handoff for greetings, confusion, account help, or name questions.\n- Do not infer handoff unless the latest user message contains a clear handoff word.\n- If the user mentions cancel, refund, or order, ask: What order ID and reason should I use before taking action?\n- If the user mentions account, ask: What account email or phone number should I use?\n- If the user greets you, asks if you are there, or asks what is going on, say that you are here and ask how you can help.\n- If the user asks about network, speed, or latency, say: We reduce latency with streaming and local voice processing.\n- Otherwise, ask one concise clarifying question.\nDo not say found, cancelled, refunded, completed, or done unless a tool result proves it."`; source=`f"{system_prompt}\n\n"`

   FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id),\n    FOREIGN KEY(user_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(id),\n    FOREIGN KEY(assistant_turn_id) REFERENCES turns(id)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interaction_events (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    interaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    channel TEXT NOT NULL,\n    transport TEXT NOT NULL,\n    event TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT,\n    text TEXT,\n    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS flow_definitions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft', 'published', 'archived')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    graph_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n    published_graph_json TEXT,\n    validation_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS flow_runs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    flow_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    conversation_id TEXT,\n    active_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slots_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',\n    transcript_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active', 'completed', 'failed')) DEFAULT 'active',\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY(flow_id) REFERENCES flow_definitions(id),\n    FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations(id)\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS flow_events (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    flow_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    node_id TEXT,\n    event TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT,\n    text TEXT,\n    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES flow_runs(id),\n    FOREIGN KEY(flow_id) REFERENCES flow_definitions(id)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_turns_conversation ON turns(conversation_id, created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_feedback_conversation ON feedback(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_interaction_events_conversation ON interaction_events(conversation_id, created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_interaction_events_interaction ON interaction_events(interaction_id, created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_flow_definitions_status ON flow_definitions(status, updated_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_flow_runs_flow ON flow_runs(flow_id, updated_at);\nCREATE
